Throughout your shift, you align staff deployment with real-time operational capacity and process documentation across internal systems. Because you interact daily with multiple operational departments, you ensure a smooth logistical flow and build an indispensable role within a growing e-commerce organization. Communicating effectively with internal departments such as purchasing, sales, and logistics.  Maintaining accurate shipment and client data in the CRM system. Spotting administrative and operational bottlenecks and solving them proactively.  Requirements  At least 2 to 3 years of proven experience in logistics planning.
